concurrency_and_state: No thread synchronization or DB/Redis calls exist in these consts files; however, ConstPlayer.HOP_THE_PORATA2/HOP_THE_PORATA3 (src/consts/ConstPlayer.java:21-22) and ConstHocKyNang.TimeUseSkill (src/consts/ConstHocKyNang.java:7) are non-final mutable public static fields.
cross_module_questions: How does the packet router / Controller distinguish colliding byte opcodes in Cmd_message (e.g., 0, 1, 2, 4, 6, 7, 13, 14, 18, 21, 35, 38, 40, 41, 50, 62-66) between top-level commands and sub-commands?
Does ConstItem.java fail javac compilation due to duplicate field name SIEU_THAN_THUY at lines 200 and 730, or is ConstItem.java excluded/patched in the build?
Which IDs are actually used for item 1109 (CHOI_PHU_THUY vs MAY_DO_BOSS) and item 1210 (TRAI_TIM_VALENTINE vs BUNMA_TOC_TIM_THAT_BIM) in ItemService/UseItem?
In ConstNpc, do SUB_MENU (31720025) and SHEN_RON_BI_NGO_CONFIRM (31720025) collide on the same NPC handler (RongThieng or ConMeo)?

findings.impact: Compile-time error if ConstItem.java is compiled with javac, preventing build or forcing IDE/stale class usage.
findings.root_cause: Duplicate field declaration `public static final int SIEU_THAN_THUY` with values 195 (line 200) and 725 (line 730) in the same class.
findings.title: Duplicate field name SIEU_THAN_THUY in ConstItem.java

findings.impact: High risk of opcode misrouting or developer confusion when adding/modifying packet handlers.
findings.root_cause: Top-level command IDs and sub-command IDs (NOT_LOGIN, NOT_MAP, SUB_COMMAND) are mixed in one flat class with many colliding byte values (e.g., 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 13, 14, 16-18, 20-23, 35, 38, 40, 41, 50, 62-66).
findings.title: Flat Cmd_message class mixes top-level and sub-command opcodes with widespread byte collisions

findings.impact: Using or checking CHOI_PHU_THUY/MAY_DO_BOSS or TRAI_TIM_VALENTINE/BUNMA_TOC_TIM_THAT_BIM triggers wrong item behavior or event item confusion.
findings.root_cause: Item ID 1109 is assigned to both CHOI_PHU_THUY and MAY_DO_BOSS; item ID 1210 is assigned to both TRAI_TIM_VALENTINE and BUNMA_TOC_TIM_THAT_BIM.
findings.title: Duplicate item ID constants in ConstItem.java (1109, 1210)

findings.impact: If handled in the same NPC switch, one menu branch becomes unreachable or triggers the wrong dialog.
findings.root_cause: Both SHEN_RON_BI_NGO_CONFIRM and SUB_MENU are assigned the identical integer 31720025.
findings.title: Colliding menu ID 31720025 in ConstNpc.java

findings.impact: Biased random drop rate favoring item 2030 (THIT_BA_CHI) twice as often as other Tet 2023 materials.
findings.title: Duplicate entry 2030 in LIST_ITEM_NLSK_TET_2023

findings.impact: Global fusion/skill constants could be accidentally mutated at runtime across threads without synchronization.
findings.root_cause: HOP_THE_PORATA2, HOP_THE_PORATA3, and TimeUseSkill are declared `public static` without `final`.
findings.title: Non-final mutable static fields in ConstPlayer and ConstHocKyNang

findings.impact: Bloated class constant pool and poor maintainability; also non-ASCII identifier ĐỔI_PHIẾU_BÉ_NGOAN (ConstNpc.java:420) risks encoding issues across toolchains.
findings.root_cause: ConstTask pre-generates thousands of `TASK_<id>_<step>` integer constants instead of a bit-shift helper method.
findings.title: Massive pre-generated task constant table in ConstTask and non-ASCII identifier in ConstNpc

key_classes.name: Cmd_message
key_classes.responsibility: Defines byte opcodes for client-server protocol commands and sub-commands.

key_classes.name: ConstItem
key_classes.responsibility: Defines item template ID constants and equipment/event item ID arrays.

key_classes.name: ConstNpc
key_classes.responsibility: Defines NPC IDs, menu action IDs, shop IDs, guide strings, and minigame text builder.

key_classes.name: ConstTask
key_classes.responsibility: Defines side/clan task limits, rewards, placeholder tokens, and pre-computed task-step IDs.

key_classes.name: BossID
key_classes.responsibility: Defines negative integer IDs for all boss instances.

module_summary: Core server constants package (`src/consts/*`) defining boss IDs/statuses/types, protocol opcodes (`Cmd_message`), item IDs (`ConstItem`), NPC/menu/shop IDs (`ConstNpc`), mob/map/player/achievement constants, and task step IDs (`ConstTask`). No DB, Redis, or Netty I/O logic resides here, but several constant collisions, a duplicate field name in `ConstItem`, and mutable static fields were observed.

protocol_touchpoints.opcode: All client-server byte opcodes (e.g., LOGIN=0, LOGOUT=0, NOT_LOGIN=-29, NOT_MAP=-28, SUB_COMMAND=-30, GIAO_DICH=-86, COMBINNE=-81, SHOP=-44, KIGUI=-100)
protocol_touchpoints.payload_summary: Constant definitions only; no serialization/deserialization performed in this file.
